propositions: Container criterion cases in plan-review-container.eval.yaml lack non-empty children lists, causing _run_criterion_case to raise ValueError before model execution
All 12 cases in plan-review-container.eval.yaml carry only input (parent plan) and no children payload, making them unrunnable through run_case unlike plan-review-decomp-shape.eval.yaml
The project's own record (eval_solver comment and decomp-shape spec) treats missing children as a fixture error requiring correction, not a valid runtime path
Each case's children must be transcribed from existing input prose descriptions (not invented), preserving expect labels and scenario semantics unchanged
Adding children payloads requires no code changes to eval_solver or provider_parity; eligible_cases picks up fixed cases automatically once fixtures carry non-empty children lists
